title: AdMuse: Skill-Guided Creative Advertising Image Generation
abstract: An outstanding creative advertising image should both attract attention and communicate a product's positioning. How to choose a persuasive conceptual bridge before rendering begins is challenging for advertising generation. We present AdMuse, a skill-guided multi-agent framework that distills high-quality advertisements into reusable creative skills for cross-domain advertising strategy. Rather than retrieving isolated exemplars, AdMuse abstracts recurring bridge patterns into a skill library that can guide new product briefs. At generation time, AdMuse coordinates skill routing, multi-candidate ideation and selection, and VLM-guided visual refinement: diverse skills propose alternative concepts, relative judgment selects the most promising direction, and vision-language feedback helps realize the selected intent in the final image. This design treats advertising creativity as a structured decision process rather than a single prompt-writing step. Experiments across diverse product and brand positionings show that AdMuse produces visually compelling advertisements that faithfully communicate product positioning.

summary.title_zh: AdMuse：技能引导的创意广告图像生成
summary.core_contribution: 提出AdMuse——一个技能引导的多智能体框架，将高质量广告提炼为可复用的创意技能，用于跨领域广告策略生成，把广告创意视为结构化决策过程而非单一步骤的提示词写作。
summary.method: 该框架首先将高质量广告中反复出现的“概念桥梁”模式抽象为可复用的技能库，而非检索孤立样例。生成时，AdMuse协调技能路由、多候选创意构思与筛选，以及VLM引导的视觉精炼：多样化技能提出备选概念，相对判断选出最有前景的方向，视觉-语言反馈帮助在最终图像中实现所选意图。
summary.findings: 在多种产品和品牌定位上的实验表明，AdMuse能够生成视觉上具有吸引力、且忠实传达产品定位的广告图像。

title: sDMD: Sinkhorn Distribution Matching Distillation
abstract: Distribution Matching Distillation (DMD) distills multi-step diffusion models into few-step generators by minimizing reverse KL divergence. Despite its strong performance, DMD guides samples by local density alone, which introduces two limitations: teacher scores can be unreliable in regions of low teacher density, and the mode-seeking behavior of reverse KL can collapse the student onto a subset of the teacher modes. We first connect DMD to Wasserstein gradient flow, showing that its gradient follows from a fixed-point formulation with integral KL (IKL) as the energy functional. This perspective motivates augmenting IKL with an optimal transport term that addresses these limitations by guiding outlier samples toward the target and promoting mode coverage. We realize this term using Sinkhorn divergence estimated from finite batches. In practice, however, errors in the estimated Sinkhorn velocity can perturb in-domain samples for which IKL guidance is already accurate. To this end, we introduce sDMD, which adaptively activates the Sinkhorn correction based on discriminator outputs, focusing on outlier samples where IKL may be unreliable. With 2--4 sampling steps on FLUX.1-dev, Qwen-Image-20B, and Wan2.1-14B, sDMD outperforms distillation baselines on GenEval, DPG, WISE, and VBench while improving sample diversity over DMD2.

summary.core_contribution: 论文提出sDMD方法，通过将分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）与Wasserstein梯度流联系，并引入基于Sinkhorn散度的最优传输项，解决了DMD中教师分数在低密度区域不可靠以及模式寻求行为导致模式坍塌的问题。
summary.method: 首先将DMD与Wasserstein梯度流关联，表明其梯度来自以积分KL（IKL）为能量泛函的不动点公式。然后，在IKL中加入最优传输项，用有限批次估计的Sinkhorn散度实现，以引导离群样本并促进模式覆盖。为避免估计的Sinkhorn速度扰动域内样本，引入sDMD，根据判别器输出自适应激活Sinkhorn校正，专注于IKL可能不可靠的离群样本。
summary.findings: 在FLUX.1-dev、Qwen-Image-20B和Wan2.1-14B上使用2-4步采样，sDMD在GenEval、DPG、WISE和VBench上优于蒸馏基线，同时相比DMD2提高了样本多样性。

title: Intrinsic Distribution Matching
abstract: One-step and few-step text-to-image generation must accurately render the details specified in the prompt despite limited opportunities for refinement. Distribution matching distillation (DMD) uses score differences to bring the generated distribution closer to a reference distribution. Following prior work, we estimate this difference with internal velocity branches, avoiding a separate fake-score network. We ask whether an explicit moment constraint improves this learned score supervision. A decomposition of the reverse-KL field into a Gaussian moment component and a non-Gaussian residual identifies statistics that can be constrained explicitly. We introduce Intrinsic Distribution Matching (IDM), which retains the full DMD correction and matches feature means and per-coordinate standard deviations using the generator's exponential-moving-average (EMA) copy, requiring no external feature encoder. Experiments use full-parameter and low-rank adaptation (LoRA) tuning on Z-Image-Turbo 6B and Qwen-Image 20B. At two network evaluations, IDM reaches 94.25% and 90.20% on Chinese and English LongText-Bench, the highest scores among the compared methods at this budget. Controlled ablations show gains from the added moment loss, while generator EMA features perform competitively with an external DINOv2 encoder across the five reported metrics. Code is available at https://github.com/inclusionAI/IDM.

summary.core_contribution: 提出内在分布匹配（IDM）方法，在分布匹配蒸馏（DMD）框架中引入显式的矩约束（特征均值与逐坐标标准差），以改进少步文本到图像生成中的得分监督质量，无需外部特征编码器。
summary.method: 将反向KL场分解为高斯矩分量与非高斯残差，识别出可显式约束的统计量。IDM在保留完整DMD校正的同时，利用生成器的指数滑动平均（EMA）副本匹配特征均值和逐坐标标准差，避免引入外部特征编码器。实验在Z-Image-Turbo 6B和Qwen-Image 20B上分别采用全参数微调和LoRA微调进行验证。
summary.findings: 在两次网络评估预算下，IDM在中英文LongText-Bench上分别达到94.25%和90.20%，为同预算对比方法中最高分。消融实验表明新增矩损失带来性能提升，且生成器EMA特征在五项报告指标上与外部DINOv2编码器表现相当。

title: Read, Allocate, Route: Role-Coupled Tokenization for Pixel-Space Generative Transformers
abstract: Pixel-space generative Transformers typically use one token per image patch, so capturing finer detail requires more tokens and makes global attention increasingly expensive. We observe that finer detail does not necessarily require more global communication: low-frequency structure benefits from global exchange, while high-frequency detail can be modeled locally. Based on this insight, we introduce SpecSlot, a pixel-space rectified-flow Transformer that decouples output detail from the length of the global attention sequence. SpecSlot expands each spatial anchor into multiple slots, each assigned a disjoint band of DCT coefficients; this separates anchor density from spectral subdivision. Only the lowest-frequency slot from each anchor participates in global attention, while all slots interact locally. This allows the model to increase spectral detail without enlarging the global sequence. A spatial head further adds a local correction to the spectral prediction, while the generative state, target, and loss remain in pixel space. On ImageNet-256, SpecSlot achieves a comparable final FID to a FLOPs-matched JiT control while converging faster. On ImageNet-512, it improves FID by 2.84 over the control with 3.9% fewer FLOPs, and comes within only 0.69 FID of JiT-B/16 at 38.2% lower cost. On text-to-image generation, SpecSlot surpasses JiT-B/8 on DPG-Bench by 1.06 at 40.6% lower forward cost.

summary.title_zh: 读、分配、路由：面向像素空间生成式Transformer的角色耦合分词
summary.core_contribution: 论文提出SpecSlot，一种像素空间整流流Transformer，通过将每个空间锚点扩展为多个分配不同DCT频带的槽位，将输出细节与全局注意力序列长度解耦，从而在不增加全局计算量的情况下提升生成细节。
summary.method: SpecSlot将每个空间锚点扩展为多个槽位，每个槽位分配一组不相交的DCT系数频带，从而将锚点密度与频谱细分分离。每个锚点仅最低频槽位参与全局注意力，所有槽位在局部进行交互。空间头对频谱预测添加局部修正，而生成状态、目标和损失均保持在像素空间。
summary.findings: 在ImageNet-256上，SpecSlot达到与FLOPs匹配的JiT控制模型相当的最终FID且收敛更快；在ImageNet-512上，FID比控制模型提升2.84且FLOPs减少3.9%，与JiT-B/16的FID差距仅0.69而成本低38.2%；在文本到图像生成中，SpecSlot在DPG-Bench上以低40.6%的前向成本超过JiT-B/8达1.06。

title: UniRA: Unified Representation Alignment and Auto-Encoding for Efficient Diffusion Generation
abstract: Diffusion transformers (DiTs) have become the dominant architecture for high-fidelity image synthesis, yet they suffer from slow training convergence and high computational cost. Two recent lines of work address this from complementary angles: Representation Alignment (REPA) accelerates DiT training by aligning intermediate features with a pretrained external representation model (e.g., DINOv2), while Representation Auto-Encoders (RAE) replace the pixel-space VAE with a compact representation-space tokenizer learned from self-supervised features. However, these approaches are developed and applied in isolation: REPA still relies on a pixel-space VAE for latent diffusion, and RAE does not exploit the alignment signal that accelerates the diffusion backbone. We present \textbf{UniRA}, a unified framework that couples representation alignment and representation auto-encoding into a single objective. UniRA learns a representation-space tokenizer whose output serves simultaneously as the diffusion target and the alignment anchor, so the tokenizer, the diffusion backbone, and the external representation model are co-optimized. We give a theoretical result showing that this joint optimization preserves the representation quality of the external model while accelerating diffusion convergence, and we derive a principled weighting that balances the reconstruction, alignment, and generation objectives. On ImageNet class-conditional generation at 256*256 and 512*512, UniRA matches or surpasses state-of-the-art DiTs (SD3, REPA, RAE) in FID while reducing training steps by up to 5*. We further show that the unified representation space supports improved zero-shot classification and linear probing, confirming that generation and understanding benefit from a shared, aligned latent space.

summary.title_zh: UniRA：面向高效扩散生成的统一表示对齐与自编码框架
summary.core_contribution: 论文提出UniRA统一框架，将表示对齐（REPA）与表示自编码（RAE）耦合为单一目标，使表示空间分词器的输出同时充当扩散目标和对外部表示模型的对齐锚点，从而实现分词器、扩散主干与外部表示模型的联合优化。
summary.method: UniRA学习一个基于自监督特征（如DINOv2）的表示空间分词器，其输出既作为扩散模型的生成目标，又作为与外部表示模型对齐的锚点，从而将重建、对齐和生成三个目标统一到一个联合优化框架中。作者给出了理论分析，证明该联合优化在保持外部模型表示质量的同时加速扩散收敛，并推导出一种有原则的权重分配方案来平衡重建、对齐与生成损失。在ImageNet 256×256和512×512类条件生成任务上进行验证。
summary.findings: 在ImageNet 256×256和512×512类条件生成上，UniRA的FID匹配或超越当前最先进的DiT方法（SD3、REPA、RAE），同时将训练步数最多减少5倍。此外，统一表示空间还支持更好的零样本分类和线性探测性能，表明生成与理解任务能够从共享的对齐潜在空间中共同受益。
